messages:
Priya: New hire hit a pretty confusing auth/rotation flow in the sampleapp today. Posting notes.
Jorge: what happened?
Priya: They used an org-scoped key in local dev (set via docker-compose): REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_org_123 and REDWOOD_PROJECT=my-sample-project in compose. App failed intermittently with 401s after rotation.
Nina: ugh. rotation + project-scoped keys interact badly with long-lived websocket streams (we cache token and never rebind project header).
Priya: repro steps I got:
```
# compose file snippet
environment:
  - REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_org_123
  - REDWOOD_PROJECT=my-sample-project
  - REDWOOD_TOKEN_LIFETIME=3600
./scripts/local-dev up
# exercise live chat -> after ~55m, messages 401
```
Jorge: Is the SDK supposed to auto-refresh tokens when using API keys? I thought only ephemeral tokens do that.
Nina: Current behavior: SDK treats API key as static credential (no refresh). We rely on infra to rotate key bindings server-side. If org rotates keys or project binding changes, client keeps sending old key header and gets 401s.
Priya: The worst part is sampleapp docker overrides REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY in different examples. That made it unclear which one the runtime prefers, and the compose sets REDWOOD_PROJECT while our quickstarts set REDWOOD_ORG. New hires set both and get subtle mismatches.
credbot: FYI: REDWOOD_KEY legacy alias still accepted but will be removed in a future deprecation cycle. Policy: prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Jorge: Proposed fixes:
- Make sampleapp composition consistent: only REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT OR only REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ORG, not both.
- SDK: detect 401s with header mismatch and surface a clear error message: "403/401 likely due to key scope (org vs project) or rotated key; try using project-scoped key or update REDWOOD_PROJECT/REDWOOD_ORG."
- Add token refresh hook for ephemeral creds / provide a reconnect/rebind flow for streams.
Nina: Also add startup self-check: if both REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT set, print a warning and prefer project (explicit > implicit).
Priya: Could we also add a short troubleshooting section in the quickstart: table of env var precedence and examples for local vs docker vs CI? New hire wasted 30m.
Jorge: I'll open a small PR to normalize compose files and add the warning in the sampleapp init. Also will add an e2e that simulates rotation by flipping a mock key.
Docs: I'll file a docs ticket for the troubleshooting table and note about rotation behavior.
credbot: Created infra ticket TKT-5421: "sampleapp: env precedence and stream reconnection for rotated keys" at 3290012397.
Priya: Thanks. One extra ask: can dev SDKs emit a metric when they encounter a scope-mismatch 401 so we can quantify how often this bites new users?
Nina: Good idea. We'll add a non-identifying telemetry ping on 401-with-scope header. Will loop in privacy.
Jorge: PR: https://git.example/redwood/sampleapp/pull/645 includes compose cleanup + startup warning.
Priya: LGTM pending tiny README wording tweak. I'll review today.
Docs: Filed: DOCS-308: "Auth env precedence & rotation troubleshooting" referencing TKT-5421.
Priya: Great. Thanks everyone.
